name: Instrument: The daypart charter template (gated on `86ajgn2z5`)
text_content:
One page per service period. This is Sŏn's replacement for her team charter, which does not map: her unit is a team inside a division inside a company, and Sŏn has strands, domains, two parallel leads, and four service periods rather than divisions.

Must contain: reason to exist; what it becomes; first customer; what it is measured by, leading indicators only; what it gives the connective layer; what makes it a worse version of dinner; what it hands on to the next period; what it draws from the previous one; operating logic; held by.

Must refuse: code names for service periods, revenue targets, any figure, and any content that reads as a description of dinner.

It is also the form the lunch decision takes. The record holds that whether lunch is built at all is an equal three-partner decision and a real option to remove. A lunch charter that cannot be written without describing a worse dinner is the record's "no good answer for lunch," arrived at structurally rather than by opinion.

Gated on the document methodology, ClickUp task 86ajgn2z5. This item specifies the instrument. It does not build it.

Filed by Session 2. Specification is in sections 11.3 and 12 of the S2 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
